name: Cafe Cup & Cino
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café Cup & Cino in Tirol!**

Discover the cozy charm of our café nestled in the heart of the **Alpenland**. Savor authentic **Tiroler** flavors in a warm, inviting atmosphere—whether you're enjoying a morning coffee with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or unwinding with a slice of homemade **Apfelstrudel** after a day of exploring the stunning **Zillertal** or the historic streets of **Innsbruck**.

Our menu features locally sourced ingredients, from fresh **Bergkäse** to artisanal **Tiroler Gröstl**. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Graubündner** wine or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from nearby breweries.

Perfect for a quick break, a romantic date, or a family outing, Café Cup & Cino is your home away from home in the **Alpen**. Come taste the warmth of **Tirol**—one cup at a time.

---
**Opening Hours:**
Mon–Fri: 7:30 AM – 6:00 PM
Sat–Sun: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM

**Location:** Right in the center of **Tirol**, just a stone’s throw from the **Nordkette** and the **Goldenes Dachl**.

**Come visit us—your adventure in Tirol starts here!** ☕️✨
